title: TPU Congestion Helius Outage History 2025
text:
TPU Congestion and Network Outages - Helius 2025

Transaction Processing Unit (TPU) congestion patterns:

Major outage causes:
1. NFT mint congestion (2021-2022): mint bots overwhelm TPU
2. QUIC transition issues (2022): protocol migration bugs
3. Duplicate block bug (2022): caused network halt 4.5 hours  
4. BPF loader congestion (2023): program deployment spam
5. Token-2022 launch congestion (2023): new token standard adoption
6. Validator client bugs (2024): Agave/Firedancer transition

TPU pipeline stages vulnerable to congestion:
- Fetch stage: receives UDP/QUIC packets
- Sigverify stage: signature verification bottleneck
- Banking stage: transaction execution bottleneck  
- Broadcast stage: block propagation bottleneck

Congestion indicators:
- transaction_drop_rate > 20%
- banking_stage_queue > 50000
- sigverify_stage_backlog > 10000
- block_production_delay > 600ms

Recovery mechanisms:
- Restart coordinator among validators
- QUIC backpressure signals
- Priority fee market adjustment
- Leader schedule rotation
Source: Helius Outage History 2025
